ability.name: Thankfulness
ability.note: This Pokémon can MP move over non-Flying-type Pokémon on the field. While this Pokémon is on the field, MP1 or lower Pokémon on your bench, and MP1 or lower Pokémon within 2 steps of this Pokémon gain +1 MP. When this Pokémon becomes frozen or when it is knocked out, this Pokémon changes its form to [CTRL FID 442][Land Forme], if possible.

wheel.name: Seed Flare
wheel.note: If there are any poisoned and/or noxious Pokémon, this damage is multiplied by the number of those Pokémon. *Removes all Poisoned and Noxious conditions from all Pokémon.

wheel.name: Dazzling Gleam
wheel.note: *Opposing Pokémon adjacent to this Pokémon spin, and if they spin a Gold Attack then they are knocked out.
